drift_correction.rationale: Visualization-only mean-shift: gen log-returns are shifted so their mean equals the real log-return mean prior to 777-step cumulative integration anchored at real_od[0]. Without this shift, per-step mean bias compounds exponentially over the 777-step horizon (V1/V2/V3 produce 8-12x OD overshoot; WGAN-CNN explodes to ~1e46), which dominates the OD panels and obscures the structural fidelity signal (variance, autocorrelation, oscillation shape) that this atlas is meant to convey. The shift is disclosed in supp \S A.10 caption; matched-budget fidelity metrics in main \S 4.2 use un-corrected log-returns and are unaffected by this visualization choice.
